_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Meaningful Holiday#000.src: So, how is it going? Did you find Nick in the slum?
Meaningful Holiday#000.dst: Eee, işler nasıl gidiyor? Nick'i kenar mahallede bulabildin mi?

Meaningful Holiday#001.src: You should follow Nick and hop in the portal right there!
Meaningful Holiday#001.dst: Nick'in peşinden gidip şuradaki geçide atlamalısın!

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I can't wait for the feast to be served. It's always magnificent.
Meaningful Holiday#002.dst: Ziyafetin sofraya gelmesini sabırsızlıkla bekliyorum. Her seferinde muhteşem oluyor.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: You want me to donate food? I'm just a guest here.
Meaningful Holiday#003.dst: Yiyecek bağışlamamı mı istiyorsun? Ben burada sadece misafirim.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: You want food for the poor? They should get jobs and help themselves!
Meaningful Holiday#004.dst: Fakirler için yiyecek mi istiyorsun? Gidip iş bulsunlar da kendilerine baksınlar!

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Why should I help them if they don't help themselves?
Meaningful Holiday#005.dst: Kendilerine yardım etmiyorlarsa ben onlara neden yardım edeyim?

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: I can't give away free food! This is the biggest feast of the year!
Meaningful Holiday#006.dst: Bedavaya yiyecek veremem! Bu, yılın en büyük ziyafeti!

Meaningful Holiday#007.src: You should go and ask charities for that.
Meaningful Holiday#007.dst: Bunun için gidip yardım kuruluşlarına sormalısın.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#008.dst: Bu yıl birilerine yardım etmek istiyorsan, patronumuz Nick şu an işin tam ortasında.
Meaningful Holiday#008.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#010.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.dst: Kusura bakma ama her şeycik tükendi, herkes Craftmas'a hazırlanıyo'.
Meaningful Holiday#010.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#011.dst: Tavan arasında bi'şeyler olabilir, bi'şey bulursan senin olsun. Ne zor olduğunu bilirim.
Meaningful Holiday#011.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.
Meaningful Holiday#013.dst: Yiyecek namına bi'şey kalmamış. Kendimi doyuracak kadar ancak var.
Meaningful Holiday#013.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#014.dst: Ha, bir de, tünele inmişken şu battaniyeyi Margaret'e verir misin? Arkamdaki yolu takip etmen yeterli.
Meaningful Holiday#014.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#016.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#016.dst: Ah, lütfen beni buradan kovma. Gidecek başka yerim yok!
Meaningful Holiday#016.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#017.dst: Selaam! Bu Craftmas ağacını süslemeyi daha yeni bitirdim!
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: I've been wrapping presents all week long.

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: My hands are starting to hurt!

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#022.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#022.dst: Hırsızlık Craftmas ruhuna yakışmaz... Ama sanırım bunu bir işe yaratabilirim.
Meaningful Holiday#022.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#023.dst: Kardeşlerimle ben Craftmas'ta insanlara göz kulak oluruz. Benim bölgem {p} çölü. Bana Kum Baba diyebilirsin, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: Merhaba canım. Benim adım Haily. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#026.dst: Burası {p} Yardım Merkezi. Bu yıl evsizlere yardım edecek gönüllüler arıyoruz.
Meaningful Holiday#026.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: Gerçekten çok özel bir adamdır. Yerini kitabına yazıvereyim. Ha, unutma, bu bir yardım işi; umarım minnet senin için yeterli bir ödüldür.
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: Haily'nin arkadaşı Nick ile yoksul mahallede konuş.

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#029.dst: Ah. Ah... Aman tanrım. Burada her zamankinden fazla insan var.
Meaningful Holiday#029.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#030.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#030.dst: Hm, buradan geçiyor muydun? Ah! Bir gönüllü!
Meaningful Holiday#030.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#031.dst: Bu yıl gelen tek kişi sensin. İşler çok değişti. Eskiden yılın bu zamanı yüzlerce gönüllümüz olurdu.
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#032.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#032.dst: Buradaki insanlar açlıktan ölüyor. Başka türlü söylemenin yolu yok.
Meaningful Holiday#032.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: Bu yıl herkesi nasıl doyuracağız, bilmiyorum.
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: Ucuz dükkânı işleten adam eskiden evsizdi... Bu insanların çektiği sıkıntıyı bilir.
Meaningful Holiday#034.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#035.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#035.dst: Ben buradaki işlere bakarım. Sen ucuz dükkâna gidebilir misin? Çok yakın. Ne yiyecek olursa minnetle kabul ederiz.
Meaningful Holiday#035.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Meaningful Holiday#036.dst: Ucuz dükkâna git ve yiyecek iste.

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#038.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#040.src: Look for food on the second floor.

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#041.dst: Hm... Bu elma daha iyi günler görmüş...
Meaningful Holiday#041.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#042.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#042.dst: Keşke bu yıl verecek bi'şeyim olsaydı. Galiba şehirde millet ziyafet çekiyo'.
Meaningful Holiday#042.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Meaningful Holiday#043.dst: Nick'e dön ve kötü haberi ver.

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: Çok da üzülemem. Yılın geri kalanında o kadar çok bağış yapıyor ki.
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#048.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: Daha önce aramız bozulmuştu, bağışın ne demek olduğunu anlamamış galiba.
Meaningful Holiday#049.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: Buradan güneye giden bir kestirme var, bir mağaranın içinde. Oradan geç.
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: Battaniyeyi Nick'in güneyindeki tünelde bulunan kadına götür.

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: Ah, bu battaniye benim için mi? Ne kadar tatlı... Nick'ten mi diyorsun? Her zaman çok iyi kalplidir... Sana da teşekkürler.
Meaningful Holiday#052.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: {p} tarafına çabucak varmak istiyorsan bu tünelden devam et. Buralarda pek dost canlısı olmayan evsizler de yaşıyor, dikkatli ol. Hâlleri çok üzücü.
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: Tünelden devam et ve Nick'in arkadaşını bul.

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: Çiftliğime hoş geldin! Taze ürünlerimden almak mı istiyorsun?
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: Eh, görünüşe göre şansın yokmuş. Bu hasattan kalanların sonunu daha yeni sattım.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#057.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#057.dst: Hepsi {p} şehrindeki o büyük Craftmas ziyafeti içindi. Keşke yardım edebilsem ama sana satacak yiyeceğim kalmadı.
Meaningful Holiday#057.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: Dur, seni Nick gönderdi, değil mi? Neyse, solundan geliyor. Ona burasının hayır kurumu olmadığını hatırlat.
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#060.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#060.dst: Hiç yiyecek bulamıyor muyuz? Seçeneklerimiz tükeniyor...
Meaningful Holiday#060.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#061.dst: Eh, yılın bu zamanında başvurabileceğimiz tek bir kişi kaldı.
Meaningful Holiday#061.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#063.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#063.dst: Etrafı keşfet ve Noel Baba'yı ara.

Meaningful Holiday#065.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#065.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#066.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Meaningful Holiday#066.dst: Noel Baba'nın evine gir ve onunla konuş.

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: Konseydeki herkesin ilgilenmesi gereken bir bölgesi var. Seninki {p}. Oraya nasıl baktığın senin sorumluluğun.
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Geçen yıla göre beş kat fazla evsiz ve aç var!
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: Nick, oralarda zor günler geçtiğini biliyorum ama-
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: Zor mu?! İmkânsız! İnsanların iyi niyetine ne oldu? Bu yıl tek bir gönüllüm vardı! TEK!
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: Üzgünüm Nick. {p} tarafına gidip orada sorabilirsin, bir orduyu doyuracak kadar büyük bir ziyafetleri var!
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Hımm... Ah, pardon. Buraya gelişini yanlış hesaplamışım. Seni gördüğüme sevindim.
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: Sanırım Noel Baba'yla konuştuklarımızı duydun. Sıradaki durağımız: {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#074.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#075.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#075.dst: Pekâlâ, o zaman mesele çözüldü. Arkamdaki şömineden çıkın, sizi doğrudan {p} tarafına götürecek. Bol şans, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#075.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#076.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#078.dst: Vay. Buradaki insanlar ne şatafat içinde yaşıyor. Doğuda insanların açlıktan öldüğünü biliyorlar mı acaba?
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#079.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#079.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#080.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#080.dst: Daha önemlisi, azıcık yiyeceklerini paylaşırlar umarım.
Meaningful Holiday#080.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#084.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#084.dst: Üstünde resmi bir kıyafet bile yok.
Meaningful Holiday#084.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: Yiyecek mi? Yiyecek mi istiyorsun? Burası sana hayır kurumu gibi mi görünüyor?
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: Tabii ki hayır! Bizim görevimiz davetlilerimizi doyurmak, çöldeki birkaç zavallı sefili değil!
Meaningful Holiday#087.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#088.dst: Şimdi güvenlik golemlerini çağırmadan defol buradan. Sakın mutfaktan bir şey çalmayı aklından bile geçirme!
Meaningful Holiday#088.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#089.dst: Mutfaktan yiyecekleri çal ve Nick ile konuş.

Meaningful Holiday#090.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#090.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#091.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#091.dst: Aldın mı?! Bu kadar cömert olacaklarını hiç beklemiyordum, koca bir kasa mı?
Meaningful Holiday#091.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#094.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#094.dst: Sen önden git. Bir planım var. Merak etme, bu yiyeceklerin hepsini geri vereceğim.
Meaningful Holiday#094.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#097.dst: Aç olduğunuzu biliyorum. Çünkü ben de açım.
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#098.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#098.dst: Ama akşam yemeğiniz bu gece servis edilmeyecek.
Meaningful Holiday#098.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: Masadaki yemek buradaki herkesi doyurmaya yetmez!
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#102.dst: Sadece bu bir gece, sadece bu bir öğün.
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#103.dst: Binlerce insan her gün böyle yaşıyor.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: Aç, yemeğin ne zaman bulunacağını merak ederek.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: Boş midelerle orada otururken sahip olduklarınız için şükredin. Sahip olmayanları da bir düşünün.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: Tıpkı sizin gibi yüzlerce erkek, kadın ve çocuk bu gece hiçbir şey yemeyecek.
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: Hepsi bu devasa ziyafet yetmediği için. {p} halkı ucuz pahalı ne varsa bütün yiyeceği satın aldı.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: Size bu günün gerçek anlamını hatırlatmak için buradayım. Başkalarını düşünmek..
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: Yemeğinizi bu gece geri vereceğim ama onu yerken... Doyurabileceği her boş ağzı hatırlamanızı istiyorum.
Meaningful Holiday#109.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#111.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#111.dst: Eh, görünüşe göre yine başardın Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#112.dst: Yardım edebilir miyim diye bakmaya geldim. Ama görünüşe göre işi sen halletmişsin.
Meaningful Holiday#112.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#113.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#113.dst: Eh, sanırım bu sahneyi tamamlamak için yapılacak tek bir şey kaldı.
Meaningful Holiday#113.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#116.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#116.dst: Görünüşe göre küçük konuşmam zenginlerin ayağını yere bastırdı.
Meaningful Holiday#116.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: Ziyafetlerinin yarısını bize verdiler. İnanabiliyor musun, yine de artan yemekleri vardı!
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#119.dst: Bu zavallı insanlarla kıyaslayınca neye sahip olduklarından haberleri yok.
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#120.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#120.dst: Noel Baba'yı nereden tanıdığımı merak ediyor olabilirsin. Şey, o benim kardeşim.
Meaningful Holiday#120.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#121.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#121.dst: Bu bayramın gerçek anlamını yaşatan senin gibi insanlar. Anlamı çarpıtıldıkça her yıl daha da zorlaşıyor. Al, bu benden sana özel bir hediye. Teşekkür ederim.
Meaningful Holiday#121.speaker: Nick
